name: ACAE Portfolio
original_description: Explore Anthony Clarke's ACAE motion-design portfolio to find creative references for a project. Search published 3D, AI, broadcast and motion-design work, inspect real portfolio images and videos in a gallery, learn about published services, and prepare an editable project-enquiry draft. Work labels come from the published portfolio. Enquiries remain unsent; the plugin does not book work or process payments.
